batch: Prueba de escala del manifiesto tipado -- 5 looks

91.titulo: Magenta Fashion Bondage en el Loft
91.concepto: VIP/Privado en arnes de fashion bondage carbon black, arquitectura M5 -- primer look de la muneca por manifiesto tipado (color cambiado de magenta a carbon black: L90 ya es familia 'pink' y no puede ir pegado).

prendas.descripcion: , fine straps crossing above and below the bust to a small chrome O-ring at the sternum, a matching waist harness sitting low on the hips with a narrow front panel of the same vinyl
worn under the harness, the sides pulled high on the hip by a small chrome ring, the back a single thin strip
a hot-pink neon garter clip pinned at the outer left thigh, her one nod to the signature pink; small chrome hoop earrings, nothing else at the throat
no hosiery this time, legs bare; hands ungloved throughout
stiletto-shaped nails at 5cm, a magenta chrome finish
closed pointed-toe platform stiletto pumps in black patent, 8-inch platform, chrome mirror finish on the platform edge, magenta undersole, a razor-thin metal needle heel

91.setting: a private loft with floor cushions and low industrial lighting

a hot-pink neon wristband on the left wrist, her signature pink carried on the stripe and the band; small chrome studs at the ears
no hosiery under the leggings, none needed; hands ungloved
coffin-shaped nails at 5cm, a gunmetal chrome gloss

no hosiery, legs bare at the high-cut hip; hands ungloved
